packageRules.description: Group non-major dev-tooling bumps (phpunit, larastan, pint, faker, mockery, collision, sail, ignition) into one PR to save runner time.
Group Docker base-image digest/patch/minor refreshes (php, mysql, composer) into one PR.
Major bumps always land as their own, individually reviewed PR (standing decision 1 / Approval Gate 5) - never grouped or automerged.
